headline: Independent study backs Sapore sourdough in salt-free bread; AMA pushes US additive overhaul
summary: An independent Moldovan-Romanian study found that 1-2% of Puratos Sapore inactive sourdough raises loaf volume and softness in salt-free wheat bread, which gives Bakery ready evidence for sodium-reduction selling.

US additive rules are tightening on several fronts: the AMA adopted a policy calling for an overhaul, FDA revoked some colour-additive production substances, and GRAS reform gains momentum with Democrats winning Congress, so the US team should audit self-affirmed GRAS ingredients and colours now.
Chocolate costs face new pressure from El Niño while Norway weighs a graduated sugar tax on chocolate, strengthening the case for Belcolade reduced-sugar and cost-optimised ranges.
Hershey's push into multi-texture bars and baked-snack collaborations, plus pandan and pistachio rising as flavours, point to opportunities for Belcolade inclusions and Patisserie fillings.
Colombia's cocoa sector is aligning with EU deforestation and cadmium rules, making it a credible origin for traceable fine-flavour cocoa.

items.title: Effect of Different Types of Sourdough on Wheat Dough Rheology and Bread Quality
items.summary: Moldovan and Romanian researchers tested four commercial inactive sourdoughs (Puratos Sapore Rigoletto, Medea, Othello, Traviata) at 1-4% in salt-free wheat bread, measuring rheology, volume, texture, colour, sodium and sensory acceptance. Low doses (1-2%) improved gas production, volume and softness; higher doses firmed the crumb.
items.why: Independent data on Puratos's own Sapore range in salt-free bread gives Bakery usable dosage guidance (1-2%) and supports sodium-reduction claims for customers.
entities: Ştefan cel Mare University of Suceava

items.title: Norway Expert Panel Proposes Graduated Sugar Tax on Chocolate and Soft Drinks
items.summary: A Norwegian expert panel has proposed a graduated sugar tax that would hit chocolate and soft drinks according to sugar content.
items.why: Graduated sugar taxes on chocolate would favour Belcolade's reduced-sugar ranges; Chocolate and Patisserie teams selling into Nordic markets should prepare reformulation options.

items.title: Replacing Eggs in Pâtisserie: The Five Jobs of the Egg and a Five-Replacer Framework from 129 Eggless Recipes
items.summary: A practitioner's framework from 129 eggless pâtisserie recipes breaks the egg into five jobs (structure, leavening, emulsification, moisture, richness) and shows that two or more replacers must be stacked.
items.why: The five-job framework is a ready checklist for Patisserie's egg-replacement solutions and customer training on eggless cakes and pastries.

items.title: FDA Revokes Authorizations of Substances for Use in Color Additive Production
items.summary: FDA has revoked authorisations for certain substances used to produce colour additives.
items.why: Colour-related revocations add to US dye restrictions; Patisserie should check colour suppliers for decorations, glazes and fillings sold in the US.

items.title: Pandan rises as a standout in global flavor trends
items.summary: Pandan is emerging as a standout global flavour in launches, with pistachio and saffron also gaining.
items.why: Pandan, pistachio and saffron are timely flavour cues for Patisserie fillings, creams and glazes.

items.title: Slideshow: The Hershey Co. doubles down on innovation
items.summary: Hershey has launched multi-texture bars, cheese puffs and baked-snack collaborations as it doubles down on innovation.
items.why: Hershey's push into multi-texture bars and baked snacks signals competitor and customer demand for inclusions, fillings and coatings that Belcolade can supply.

items.title: Enhanced non-covalent interactions and structural reorganization in gluten networks enable low-glycemic bread with 30% modified rice bran
items.summary: A Food Hydrocolloids study shows that 30% modified rice bran can be built into a gluten network to give a low-glycemic bread.
items.why: Rice bran as an upcycled fibre for low-GI bread is worth tracking for Bakery's fibre-enrichment and health-claim pipeline.

items.title: Constructing quality from below: convention theory and regulatory alignment in the Colombian cocoa value chain
items.summary: Interviews with 22 Colombian cocoa stakeholders show how quality conventions (agroforestry, cadmium testing, traceability, fine-flavour recognition) are aligning the sector with EU deforestation and cadmium rules.
items.why: Colombia's progress on EUDR and cadmium compliance makes it a candidate origin for Belcolade's diversified, traceable fine-flavour cocoa sourcing.

items.title: AMA Adopts New Policy Aimed at Overhauling U.S. Food Additive Regulations
items.source: Florida Hospital News and Healthcare Report
items.summary: The American Medical Association adopted a policy calling for an overhaul of US food additive regulation.
items.why: AMA backing adds momentum to tighter US additive rules (GRAS, dyes); all units should map additives in North American formulations that could face scrutiny.

items.title: AMA adopts policy aimed at overhauling U.S. food additive regulations
items.summary: AMA announcement of its newly adopted policy to overhaul US food additive regulation, including how substances are deemed safe.
items.why: Medical-association pressure raises the odds of stricter GRAS and additive rules; Bakery, Patisserie and Chocolate should review self-affirmed GRAS ingredients in US products.

items.title: Americans are already paying more for candy. Could El Niño make chocolate even costlier this Christmas, Va
items.summary: US candy prices are already rising, and El Niño weather threatens to push chocolate costs higher again this Christmas.
items.why: Renewed cocoa-price pressure from El Niño supports demand for Belcolade compounds, cocoa extenders and cost-saving recipes from North American customers.

items.title: US industry and advocates split on GRAS reform as Democrats win Congress
items.summary: US industry and consumer advocates are split over GRAS reform, and Democrats winning Congress changes the outlook for legislation.
items.why: A new Congress could accelerate GRAS reform; Puratos US should track bills and prepare safety dossiers for self-affirmed GRAS ingredients used in bakery, patisserie and chocolate.

items.title: GFF’s Erin Ball slices into bread
items.summary: Grain Foods Foundation's Erin Ball discusses a GFF study on what is behind slow US bread sales.
items.why: Insight into why US bread sales are slowing helps Bakery shape its message and product ideas for North American industrial customers.

items.title: Upcycled Brewing Protein Ingredients: Duynie Transforms Brewers' Spent Grain into Protein
items.summary: Duynie is turning brewers' spent grain into a protein ingredient.
items.why: Upcycled spent-grain protein is a fibre/protein enrichment candidate for Bakery and a possible sourcing partner.

items.title: Teamsters to Hochul: GRAS bill must be vetoed
items.summary: The Teamsters are urging New York Governor Hochul to veto a state GRAS bill.
items.why: A New York GRAS disclosure law would affect ingredient suppliers selling into the state; Puratos US should watch the veto decision.
